preconditions.description: For each test case, the next two lines contain exactly m integers each, where m is the number of columns specified in the first line of the test case.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 10**4 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for num in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each cell value a_{i,j} is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t integers, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.split()[i] == str(score) for i, score in enumerate(compute_scores(stdin)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer is the optimal score of the game, where Alice minimizes Bob's maximum possible coins collected from cells not visited by Alice.
